name: Midara Gari
source:
One day educational practitioners come to protagonist's school. One female college student out of them made a big fuss. Naturally, hero can't take his eyes from her beauty. And when the day of  practical training comes, teacher suddenly appears in his room offering private service. She turns out to be a devil who imbues protagonist with magical power to commit any girls he lusts for.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某一天，一批教育实习生来到了主人公就读的学校，其中一名女大学生在校园里引起了不小的轰动。主人公自然也被她的美貌迷得移不开视线。而当正式实习授课的日子到来时，这名实习女老师竟突然出现在他的房间里，主动提出为他提供“私人特别服务”。原来她的真实身份是一名恶魔，并将一股能够随心所欲占有任何心仪女孩的魔力赋予了主人公。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
